name: Cat's Brain
notes: Seeded from Wiltshire HER extract in Zenodo 11005373 (certainty=Possible). Cat's Brain long barrow, field Cats Brain SE of Hilcott, parish North Newnton (Vale of Pewsey). HE Research Records Hob 1483725; Wiltshire SMR Su15NW614; NMR SU 15 NW 143; NGR SU1185157891. Cropmark U-ditch ~26×20 m E–W, open to the east; plough-levelled. University of Reading Vale of Pewsey Project (Jim Leary); main excavation 2017 revealed an early Neolithic trapezoidal timber hall (~19–20 m × ~10 m at the front) with flanking ditches; no human remains; decorated chalk blocks in a posthole. Marshall, Leary et al., HE Research Report 97/2024 (Jan 2025): timber hall 38th century cal BC; extended ~3700 cal BC; chalk barrow wrapping in the first half of the 37th century cal BC.

notes: Seeded from Wiltshire HER extract in Zenodo 11005373 (certainty=Possible). Kutty region tag: Stonehenge. azimuth_prefer_note: left indistinct after human review. HER MWI13159 = Neolithic long barrow (Roberts WS71, excavated 2015–16, NE-SW, unscheduled as a long barrow). NHLE 1011046 at the same NGR is scheduled as a levelled BOWL BARROW (26 m diameter, 1995). NHLE polygon PCA (63.1°) is that circular scheduling outline, not a long-barrow axis — do not use as Neolithic long-axis evidence.
